summary: ALCS Game 3 in Cleveland: Williams vs. converted reliever Griffin Jax, lineups posted, 57 and sunny. Tampa Bay strikes out less than most teams, so we trimmed the Williams strikeout projection back toward his season rate.

legs.note: Games 1 and 2 of this series were low scoring, and both bullpens are rested after an off day. Williams is missing bats at an elite rate, and Tampa Bay will use relievers from the 3rd inning on.
This is the same Under read with an extra half run of cushion, at a shorter price.

extra_legs.note: Williams averaged 7.75 strikeouts a start this season (12.1 per 9) and has 23 in two playoff starts. Tampa Bay strikes out only 18.8% of the time, though, so we project about 7.
He averaged 17 outs a start this season, so this mostly depends on Cleveland's hook. We now see no edge here.
Jax is a converted reliever who topped out at 82 pitches this year, and he threw only 2 innings in his last playoff outing. Tampa Bay pulls starters early in the playoffs.
extra_legs.status: Confirmed starter. He's a converted reliever on a short leash
